definition: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.
exampleSentence: The remote archipelago became an increasingly popular eco-tourism destination.
Our guide provided a detailed travel itinerary covering all major sights.

definition: A room, group of rooms, or building in which someone may live or stay.
exampleSentence: We booked comfortable self-catering accommodation near the harbor.

definition: A short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.
exampleSentence: The tour package includes a guided boat excursion along the fjords.

definition: An object or feature of a landscape or town that is easily seen and recognized.
exampleSentence: The bell tower is the most recognizable architectural landmark in the capital.

definition: The action of leaving, especially on a journey.
exampleSentence: Passengers gathered near gate seven awaiting flight departure.

definition: An arrangement by which accommodations are secured in advance.
exampleSentence: We phoned the boutique hotel to confirm our room reservation.

definition: A traveler on a public or private conveyance.
exampleSentence: Each rail passenger is entitled to two medium-sized suitcases.

definition: A thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event.
exampleSentence: She bought hand-painted ceramic tiles as souvenirs from Lisbon.

definition: The activity of visiting places of interest in a location by tourists.
exampleSentence: We dedicated the first two days of our city trip to sightseeing.
